description: The numeric settings of the wrapper runtimes, read from the environment. This file is the single source: each runtime declares the same names, defaults, minimums and policies (its test compares them to this file), and the table of the settings is generated from it. policy 'strict': an invalid value stops the wrapper at start; policy 'tolerant': an invalid value (missing, not an integer, below the minimum) is ignored and the default is used.

settings.name: BRIQUE_MAX_CONCURRENCY
settings.what: Engine-routed capacity and Matter works that run at the same time in the wrapper (the execution slots).

settings.name: BRIQUE_QUEUE_LIMIT
settings.what: Works that may wait for a slot; beyond it a call is refused 'busy' before it runs.

settings.name: BRIQUE_TRANSIT_MAX_BYTES
settings.what: Largest serialized parameter sent as a transit file; above it a transient Matter is used.

settings.name: BRIQUE_TRANSIT_TTL_SECONDS
settings.what: Lifetime of an abandoned transit reference before it is swept.

settings.name: BRIQUE_BUSY_ATTEMPTS
settings.what: Attempts in all (the first included) of a call refused because its callee is busy.

settings.name: BRIQUE_BUSY_BASE_MS
settings.what: Pause before the second attempt of a call refused 'busy'; doubled at each attempt, times a random factor from 0.5 to 1.5.

settings.name: BRIQUE_BUSY_CAP_MS
settings.what: Ceiling of the pause between two attempts of a call refused 'busy'.

settings.name: BRIQUE_LEASE_TIMEOUT_MS
settings.what: Time allowed to one HTTP transfer through a Matter lease.

settings.name: BRIQUE_LEASE_RETRIES
settings.what: Reads of a Matter whose lease went stale (the substance changed meanwhile) before giving up.

settings.name: BRIQUE_CAS_ATTEMPTS
settings.what: Attempts of a read-recompute-write that keeps losing the race on the revision.

settings.name: BRIQUE_CAS_PAUSE_BASE_MS
settings.what: After a lost race, a pause of random length up to this, doubled at each attempt.

settings.name: BRIQUE_CAS_PAUSE_CAP_MS
settings.what: Ceiling of the pause after a lost race: writers that lost the same round do not come back together.

settings.name: BRIQUE_HEARTBEAT_MS
settings.what: Period of the `running` acknowledgement of a long capacity (it renews the inactivity budget of whoever waits for it).
